events.region: Kings (Brooklyn); Southwest Suffolk; Southeast Suffolk; Southern Queens; Southern Nassau
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 5
to 9 feet expected in the surf zone. For the High Rip Current
Risk, dangerous rip currents expected.

* WHERE...Kings (Brooklyn), Southwest Suffolk, Southeast
Suffolk, Southern Queens and Southern Nassau Counties.

* WHEN...From 6 AM to 9 PM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion. Life-threatening rip currents are
likely for all people entering the surf zone. Anyone visiting
the beaches should stay out of the surf. Rip currents can
sweep even the best swimmers away from shore into deeper water.

events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...A portion of Big Bend Florida, including the following
county, Franklin.

* WHEN...Until 530 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Ponding of water in urban or other areas is occurring or is
imminent.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 326 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Morgan Place, Fort Gadsden, Hays Place, Buck Siding and
Beverly.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.summary:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as 78 to 82.

* WHERE...Central Copper Valley, McCarthy, and Southern Copper
Valley.

* WHEN...Until 9 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Daytime temperatures across the Copper River

temperatures will be along the Edgerton Highway and McCarthy Road.

respite from the warm temperatures.
